title: Search page: component and doc result groups print raw i18n keys (search.typeComponents, search.typeDocs, search.badgeComponent, search.badgeDoc)
body:
## What happens

The full search page (`/_console/apps/<app>/search`, reached from the ⌘K palette's "Open Full Search Page") prints raw i18n keys for two of its result groups and their badges:

- group headings: `search.typeComponents`, `search.typeDocs`
- item badges: `search.badgeComponent`, `search.badgeDoc`

The other groups are translated (对象 / 仪表盘 / 报表 under zh-CN).

## Steps

1. Console 18.6.0, any app whose navigation has a component item (e.g. an approvals inbox, `/component/approvals/inbox`) and a docs item (a manual, `/docs/<book>`).
2. Press ⌘K → "Open Full Search Page" (zh-CN: 打开完整搜索页面).
3. Read the group headings and the badge on each card.

## Actual

```
search.typeComponents   1
  待我审批              search.badgeComponent
search.typeDocs         1
  服务手册              search.badgeDoc
```

## Expected

A translated heading and badge for component and doc items in every shipped locale, as for objects, dashboards, pages and reports.

## Cause, as far as read

On `main`, the `search` block of `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` and `zh-Hans.ts` carries `typeObjects`, `typeDashboards`, `typePages`, `typeReports` and `badgeObject`, `badgeDashboard`, `badgePage`, `badgeReport` only. There is no `typeComponents`, `typeDocs`, `badgeComponent` or `badgeDoc` in either file, so the keys are missing in English too, not only in the translation. The page's placeholder ("Search objects, dashboards, pages, reports…") also does not name the two newer kinds.

## Environment

`@objectstack/*` 18.6.0, console UI in zh-CN, Chromium. Seen in a HotCRM app (service app: one component item, one docs item).
